verdicts.reason: A is broken: the headline is split, with 'GET A GIFT' tiny at left and 'with your next cup of coffee' in huge white text over the busy sweater and mug, so it is hard to read and collides with the image. The 'Only this Christmas' and URL text is microscopic, the stars are oversized, the dashed lines cross the photo, and the reading order is jumbled. B keeps the copy in one centred block on clean pink, with the order intact and no collisions with the photo. Its flaws are tiny type (URL, 'Only this Christmas', logo), a large dead pink area to the left of the block, a cramped icon row, and a headline that is too small for the banner.
